svg.title: Bottleneck Migration Network
svg.desc: A network organized by four industry domains and four bottleneck depths. Solid lines show current replication paths; purple dashed lines show substitute routes not yet adopted. Every substitute route continues through D2 and D3.
svg.text: Columns measure response distance from D0; solid lines are current routes, purple dashed lines are available but not yet adopted.

svg.text: Fill encodes depth and node type; purple dashed borders encode substitute routes. The two dimensions are independent.
